stimulus.title: Thông báo tại sân bay
stimulus.audio_script: Woman: Attention, passengers on Coastal Air flight 208 to Lisbon. Because of a mechanical issue, this flight will now depart from gate fourteen instead of gate nine. The new departure time is four forty-five, about an hour later than scheduled. We apologize for the inconvenience. Passengers holding a boarding pass for this flight may pick up a meal voucher at the customer service desk across from gate twelve. Thank you for your patience.

stimulus.title: Tin nhắn thoại
stimulus.audio_script: Man: Hello, this message is for Ms. Ayana Brooks. This is Tom from Clearview Dental Clinic. I'm calling to remind you about your appointment with Dr. Fischer tomorrow at ten thirty. Please remember to bring your new insurance card, since we don't have it on file yet. If you need to change the time, please call us before five o'clock today so we can offer the slot to another patient. Our number is 555-0174. Thank you.

stimulus.title: Hướng dẫn tham quan bảo tàng
stimulus.audio_script: Woman: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Halvorsen Maritime Museum. My name is Ingrid, and I'll be your guide today. Our tour will last about ninety minutes. We'll start in the main hall, where you can see a full-size model of a nineteenth-century fishing boat. Please note that photography is allowed in most areas, but not in the special exhibition on the second floor. At the end of the tour, you're welcome to visit our gift shop, where all visitors today receive ten percent off.

stimulus.title: Phát biểu tại cuộc họp nhân viên
stimulus.audio_script: Man: Before we finish today's staff meeting, I have some news. Starting next month, we'll be using a new scheduling app to manage shifts. Instead of checking the paper schedule in the break room, you'll be able to see your shifts and request changes on your phone. To help everyone get used to it, Ms. Okoro from the IT department will hold two short training sessions next Tuesday, one at nine and one at two. Please sign up for one of them on the sheet by the door.

stimulus.title: Quảng cáo trên radio
stimulus.audio_script: Woman: Is your kitchen looking old and tired? At Renova Home Design, we can give it a complete makeover in just two weeks. Our experienced designers will visit your home, listen to your ideas, and create a plan that fits your budget. And this month only, customers who book a free consultation will receive new kitchen lighting at no extra cost. Visit our showroom on Granger Avenue or book online at renova-home dot com.

stimulus.title: Bản tin giao thông
stimulus.audio_script: Man: This is Rob Kessler with your seven o'clock traffic report. Drivers heading downtown on Highway 9 should expect delays of about twenty minutes because of road repairs near the Elm Street exit. Two lanes will be closed until the end of the week. If possible, take River Road instead. Also, a reminder that the city marathon is this Sunday, so several streets in the city center will be closed from six A.M. to two P.M. Up next, we'll have the weather forecast.

stimulus.audio_script: Woman: Welcome to the twelfth annual Green Building Conference. I'm Dr. Helen Park, the chair of this year's organizing committee. Before we begin, a few quick notes. stimulus.title: Tin nhắn ghi âm tự động của công ty
stimulus.audio_script: Man: Thank you for calling Linden Electric. Our office hours are Monday through Friday, eight A.M. to six P.M. If you are calling to report a power outage, please press one.
